overview: The board approved a special permit for a plasma donation center at Fellsway Plaza and recommended approval to the Zoning Board of Appeals for a five-story laboratory addition at 200 Boston Avenue. It also re-endorsed expanding the Zoning Board of Appeals membership and authorized a partial bond release for the Macklin Road subdivision.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the June 10, 2021 meeting.

items.title: Special Permit and Site Plan Review: 640–760 Fellsway
items.summary: Approved site plan waivers and granted a special permit to BioLife Plasma Services LP to convert a former retail space into a plasma donation center, conditioned on traffic calming, bicycle accommodations, and pedestrian improvements.

items.title: Zoning Amendment: Zoning Board of Appeals Membership
items.summary: Voted to resubmit its recommendation to the City Council supporting a mayoral petition to expand the Zoning Board of Appeals from three members to five, with staggered terms.

items.title: Site Plan Review Recommendation: 200 Boston Avenue
items.summary: Voted to recommend that the Zoning Board of Appeals approve a five-story research, testing, and parking addition at 200 Boston Avenue, subject to design and mitigation conditions regarding lighting, tree canopy, and pedestrian and bicycle enhancements.

items.title: Bond Release: Macklin Road Definitive Subdivision
items.summary: Approved reducing the performance bond to $17,135, waiving the underground electric requirement for lot one and authorizing the administrative release of the remaining funds upon final staff sign-offs.

items.title: Rules and Regulations and Miscellaneous Updates
items.summary: Continued the review of updated board operating rules to the next meeting and discussed upcoming permit extension requests and board member terms.
